[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (48.2→61.9): 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착 진행 중.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.6049→1.7124): 개선세 지속, 강세 확산 신호.

· 스윙 저항선 ($187.12): 52주 고점 돌파 시 추가 상승 여력.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low): 회복 추세 강화.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.80배): 상승 움직임 신뢰도 증가.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적 구간 후 상승 추세 전환): 1배수 목표 비중 채움, 신호 강화 시 레버리지 검토.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($174.28) vs SMA5/20/50 ($167.26/$161.73/$172.35): Above short/mid-term trends, consolidating above long-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($157.28/$144.82): Strong mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (76.8%) + approaching historical high price levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.2→61.9): Exiting oversold territory, moving towards neutral zone consolidation.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6049→1.7124): Continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $161.73): Attempting to approach upper band after consolidating near mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($149.00): Based on 52-week low and Pivot S2.
· Swing resistance ($187.12): Potential for further upside on breaking 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low): Strengthening recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.80x): Increased confidence in upward movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Transitioning to uptrend after accumulation): 1x target allocation filled, leverage to be considered on signal strengthening.
